verdict.rationale: Logseq stores data as local Markdown/EDN files under user control and offers full export (Markdown, JSON, EDN, etc.), giving users de facto ability to retain or delete their data by managing files directly; sync is end-to-end encrypted. However, there is no explicit documentation of a data-deletion feature, retention policy, or account/data-erasure controls for the Sync/cloud service, and community threads note sync reliability issues rather than retention controls. Missing for 10: explicit deletion/retention policy documentation for cloud sync, account data-erasure mechanism, and independent confirmation of these controls working as described.
